metadata.title: ONCA Procedural Decision Breakdown (2020-2026)
metadata.description: Ontario Court of Appeal decision types - showing procedural vs. substantive outcomes
metadata.data_quality: Outcome-classified from decision text; worker injury cases represent <1% of dataset
metadata.key_insight: ONCA decisions are predominantly Unknown/Procedural (58.1%) and Appeal Dismissed (20.3%). Use for precedent research, not outcome comparison.

unknown_procedural.label: Unknown/Procedural
unknown_procedural.description: Outcome not classified or purely procedural decision

appeal_dismissed.label: Appeal Dismissed
appeal_dismissed.description: Lower court/tribunal decision upheld - appellant loses
examples: Appeal dismissed - no error in law

costs_decision.label: Costs Decision
costs_decision.description: Party ordered to pay other side's legal costs
examples: Appellant ordered to pay respondent costs

appeal_allowed.label: Appeal Allowed
appeal_allowed.description: Lower court/tribunal decision overturned - appellant wins
examples: Appeal allowed - error in law found

motion_interlocutory.label: Motion/Interlocutory Decision
examples: Stay of lower court decision pending appeal

new_trial_hearing.label: New Trial/Hearing Ordered
new_trial_hearing.description: Case sent back for new hearing at lower level

remitted.label: Remitted to Lower Court/Tribunal
remitted.description: Case sent back to lower court/tribunal for reconsideration
examples: Lower court to reconsider in light of new law

settled_discontinued.label: Settled/Discontinued
settled_discontinued.description: Case settled or withdrawn before decision

appeal_success_analysis.note: Success rate calculated from classified appeal outcomes only (excludes Unknown, Costs, Motions, Leave decisions)

worker_injury_cases.note: ONCA decisions include appeals from all tribunal types. Worker injury cases represent <1% of dataset.
worker_injury_cases.interpretation: Most worker injury appeals stop at tribunal level (WSIAT, HRTO) or Divisional Court. Very few reach ONCA.
worker_injury_cases.key_finding: ONCA is a precedent layer for legal interpretation, not a workplace injury outcomes database.

use_cases.precedent_research: ✅ Primary use—search ONCA decisions for legal interpretation relevant to your case
use_cases.outcome_comparison: ❌ NOT recommended—ONCA is appellate, not first-level tribunal. Outcomes are procedural, not merit-based.
use_cases.appeal_strategy: ✅ Use to understand leave to appeal standards and what grounds succeed
use_cases.legal_interpretation: ✅ Use to see how courts interpret tribunal statutes and standards of review
use_cases.standards_of_review: ✅ ONCA sets standards for reviewing tribunal decisions (reasonableness, correctness)

methodology.data_source: Ontario Court of Appeal decisions via CanLII (2020-2026)
methodology.classification_method: Outcome pattern matching from decision text
methodology.limitations: Worker injury cases represent <1% of total; 58.1% of decisions have unknown/unclassified outcomes; sample primarily procedural decisions
